_help: systems: just a mass parameter. scenarios: mu + particles. A particle is one of: {at:'L4',dx,dy,vx,vy} (offset from an equilibrium, velocities in the rotating frame), {x,y,vx,vy}, {around:'secondary',r} (prograde circular orbit), or {swarm:'L4',radius,count}. Optional per scenario: half (zoom), center ('bary'|'m2'|'L1'..), frame ('rotating'|'inertial').
